playstyle: A six-strong Beastmen herd built around two sturdier 4-Health brutes, Grashrak and Draknar, backed by four fragile 2-Health gors, all moving at a steady 4. Draknar hits hard for 3 damage, while Ushkor and Gnarl add range-3 chip shots and Korsh reaches 2 hexes. With no warscroll of its own, it borrows a generic Chaos warscroll and leans on numbers, either swarming neutral territory to Inspire or trading bodies to secure melee kills, winning through attrition and board presence.
